parsed.rationale: Both participating records have is_test=true: 'iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession' in Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift and 'EntityResolverMockWebSession' in Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift. Although they share the field 'requestedURLs:[URL]', the differing slot ('responses:[Data]' vs 'responses:[String: Data]') reflects genuinely different stubbing contracts for their respective network layers — one returns ordered sequential responses, the other a keyed dictionary. Collapsing them into a generic shared test helper would couple two unrelated test packages and obscure the intent of each fixture. Per the decision rules, all-test clusters are intentional duplication.
